parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the bottle, appearing as a matte brown plastic container with a tapered neck.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the liquid contents and provides the structural volume for the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would grasp the mid-section of the cylinder firmly to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded plastic bottles are thin-walled shells enclosing air or liquid.

parts.description: The main cylindrical body of the bottle, appearing as a matte brown plastic container with a tapered neck.
parts.function: Holds the liquid contents and provides the structural volume for the pump mechanism.

parts.name: label band

physics.Basic_description: A beige/cream colored band wrapped around the center of the bottle body.
physics.Functional_description: Serves as a label area for branding or content identification.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp target; gripping here might slip or damage the label.
physics.reason: A paper or plastic film label is effectively a solid thin sheet relative to its scale.

parts.description: A beige/cream colored band wrapped around the center of the bottle body.
parts.function: Serves as a label area for branding or content identification.

parts.name: neck threads

physics.Basic_description: The threaded upper section of the bottle neck, visible as white ridges in the RGB view.
physics.Functional_description: Engages with the collar/cap to seal the bottle and secure the pump assembly.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and specific for grasping; used for mating with the cap.
physics.reason: The neck finish is typically thick enough to be treated as solid material for manipulation purposes.

parts.description: The threaded upper section of the bottle neck, visible as white ridges in the RGB view.
parts.function: Engages with the collar/cap to seal the bottle and secure the pump assembly.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: The white ribbed ring at the very top, acting as the screw cap or collar base.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the sprayer head to the bottle neck via threading.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to unscrew the pump assembly from the bottle.
physics.reason: Injection molded caps are hollow shells.

parts.description: The white ribbed ring at the very top, acting as the screw cap or collar base.
parts.function: Secures the sprayer head to the bottle neck via threading.

parts.name: collar knurl

physics.Basic_description: The textured vertical ridges on the white collar, providing grip.
physics.Functional_description: Increases friction for fingers or grippers to rotate the collar.
physics.Grasped_description: Ideal surface for a gripper to apply torque for opening/closing.
physics.reason: The knurling is part of the cap wall structure, effectively solid at this scale.

parts.description: The textured vertical ridges on the white collar, providing grip.
parts.function: Increases friction for fingers or grippers to rotate the collar.

parts.name: sprayer body

physics.Basic_description: The internal housing of the pump mechanism, visible as the brown section below the collar in some views (though segmentation maps it specifically).
physics.Functional_description: Contains the piston and spring mechanism for pumping liquid.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasping here might interfere with the trigger mechanism.
physics.reason: Pump housings are complex injection molded shells with internal cavities.

parts.description: The internal housing of the pump mechanism, visible as the brown section below the collar in some views (though segmentation maps it specifically).
parts.function: Contains the piston and spring mechanism for pumping liquid.

parts.name: nozzle

physics.Basic_description: The small protrusion where the mist exits, appearing as a tiny tab.
physics.Functional_description: Directs and atomizes the liquid spray.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to grasp; avoid contact.
physics.reason: Small nozzles are typically solid plastic with a tiny drilled hole.

parts.description: The small protrusion where the mist exits, appearing as a tiny tab.
parts.function: Directs and atomizes the liquid spray.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: The long thin brown rod extending from the bottom of the pump assembly.
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp; it is flexible and easily bent or detached.
physics.reason: Dip tubes are hollow pipes to allow fluid flow.

parts.description: The long thin brown rod extending from the bottom of the pump assembly.
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump.

parts.name: trigger lever

physics.Basic_description: The small lever protruding from the side of the pump head.
physics.Functional_description: Actuated by the user to compress the pump spring and dispense liquid.
physics.Grasped_description: Pressing this part actuates the spray; a gripper could press it to test function.
physics.reason: Trigger levers are typically solid injection molded beams to withstand finger pressure.

parts.description: The small lever protruding from the side of the pump head.
parts.function: Actuated by the user to compress the pump spring and dispense liquid.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
